verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Enterprise/Team plans include admin-oriented security features like audit logs and a Compliance API for usage/data access, which support data-policy oversight, but there is no documented evidence of member management or granular permission/role controls for admins. missing for 10: explicit member invite/removal workflows, role-based permission settings, and workspace-wide data policy configuration (e.g., retention, SSO/SCIM) documentation.
